name: Deferred - Old Enemy - 2
description: Second returns for old enemies from earlier chapters of a life.

results.description: [social -1] The enemy from {origin} at last dealt you an open injury, and took plain pleasure in how cleanly it was done.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [money -40] An old enemy from {origin} cost you coin by forcing you into haste, loss, or apology.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [bio RollTable.wc0827FvVWKn4eJO] The feud born in {origin} did not ruin you, yet it left your name a little easier to doubt.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [body] The old enmity from {origin} at last marked your flesh, where before it had marked only your prospects.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [social -1] Your enemy from {origin} found a courteous way to make others think the less of you.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [bio RollTable.mWI6zmHkHhQA84Yp] The old rival from {origin} drew you into trouble and slipped most of the blame.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [social 1] The enemy first made in {origin} overreached so far that your own restraint began to look like virtue.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [money -20] An old score from {origin} was settled in inconvenience, delay, and one expense you could not escape.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [body] The hatred born in {origin} ceased to be a mere idea when steel, fist, or mishap carried it further.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [bio RollTable.kC0YeELeXOdwDeaJ] You outlasted the enemy from {origin}, which is among the dullest but surest forms of victory.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [social -1] Someone from {origin} at last found the moment to speak against you where it would tell.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [money -30] The old quarrel from {origin} cost you a chance that, in a quieter life, would have been yours.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [social 1] The enmity from {origin} ended when your adversary made himself ridiculous before witnesses who mattered.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [bio RollTable.wc0827FvVWKn4eJO] An enemy from {origin} did what little he could, and that little was enough to be remembered but not obeyed.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [body] The old conflict from {origin} left its last word upon your body, and then at last fell silent.
results.name: old-enemy-2

results.description: [social 1] The enemy you made in {origin} failed against you so openly that the victory raised your standing.
results.name: old-enemy-2
